title: US NIPA Comprehensive-Revision Timeline (Phase-0 canonical reference)
scope: US Bureau of Economic Analysis National Income and Product Accounts (NIPAs), comprehensive updates and table-renumbering events relevant to the RSCD replication of Shaikh (2016).
note_on_count: BEA counts 16 comprehensive updates of the National (Economic) Accounts through 2023. This file details the modern set (1999-2023) that bear on Shaikh's 2011-vintage construction and any post-book extension. Pre-1999 comprehensive revisions (…1980, 1985, 1991, 1996) are out of RSCD scope and omitted.

cross_checks.local_kb_METHODOLOGY_CHANGES_2010_2025: Confirms 2013 (R&D capitalization, +~$400B GDP), 2018, 2023 comprehensive revisions. Local doc is thinner and gives 'effective July 2013 / July 2018 / September 2023'; this file adds exact release dates and the 1999/2003/2009 rows the local doc omits.
cross_checks.local_NIPA_T711_FISIM_remap: Confirms the 2013 FISIM restatement (no T7.11 row-order change) and the 2018 +1 line shift in T7.11 financial-corporate monetary-interest block. Reproduced in table_renumbering_events below.

revisions.what_changed: Recognized business and government purchases of software AND own-account software production as fixed investment (new 'software' asset). Switched featured aggregates fully to chain-type (Fisher) quantity/price indexes with updated reference year. Reclassified government consumption vs. government investment. Improved bank-service and insurance imputations.
revisions.verification: web-verified (BEA SCB Aug 1999 preview + Nov/Dec 1999 initial results)

revisions.what_changed: Revised measurement of implicitly priced banking services (reference-rate / FISIM-style approach) and of property-casualty insurance services. Extended software capitalization to own-account development of software originals used for reproduction. New and redesigned NIPA tables and presentations.
revisions.verification: web-verified (BEA 'Information on previous updates' page; SCB Sept 2003 preview, Dec 2003/Jan 2004 results)

revisions.what_changed: Incorporated the 2002 benchmark input-output accounts. Changes in definitions, classifications, statistical methods, source data, and presentation. Reclassifications flowing from the 2002-NAICS benchmark I-O feed into industry detail.
revisions.verification: web-verified (BEA 'Information on previous updates' page; release 2009-07-31)

revisions.what_changed: Capitalized R&D expenditures as fixed investment. Capitalized entertainment, literary, and artistic originals as investment. These two created the new 'intellectual property products' (IPP) fixed-investment category. Adopted accrual accounting for defined-benefit pension plans. Expanded residential ownership-transfer costs recognized as fixed investment. Incorporated the 2007 benchmark input-output accounts. Improved measures of commercial banking services (FISIM restatement by sector, no T7.11 row-order change). Raised measured GDP level by roughly $400 billion.
series_families_affected: Private Fixed Investment (new IPP category: R&D + entertainment originals)
revisions.verification: web-verified (BEA SCB March 2013 preview + BEA FAQ 1024; results SCB Sept 2013). Cross-checks local METHODOLOGY_CHANGES_2010_2025 and CH6/CH7 vintage-drift warnings.

revisions.what_changed: Incorporated the 2012 benchmark input-output accounts. New and improved methods for measuring financial services and nonprofit institutions. Revisions to personal saving. New table presentations. Inserted a new monetary-interest sub-row in the T7.11 financial-corporate block, shifting subsequent T7.11 line numbers by +1 (see table_renumbering_events).
revisions.verification: web-verified (BEA SCB April 2018 preview + Sept 2018 update; release 2018-07-27). T7.11 +1 shift cross-checked against local NIPA_T711_FISIM_remap.md.

revisions.revision_name: 2023 Comprehensive Update of the National Economic Accounts (16th comprehensive)
revisions.what_changed: First fully harmonized comprehensive update of the National Economic Accounts: concurrent release of the NIPAs and the Industry Economic Accounts, incorporating the 2017 benchmark supply-use / input-output tables. Reference year updated to 2017. Changes stemming from 2017 NAICS are small (no summary- or sector-level industry reclassifications). Methodological improvements to selected components.
revisions.verification: web-verified (BEA SCB June 2023 preview + BEA 2023 updates page; initial results released 2023-09-28)

table_renumbering_events.table: NIPA T7.11 (Interest Paid and Received by Sector and Legal Form of Organization)
table_renumbering_events.event: 2018 Comprehensive Update inserted one new monetary-interest sub-row in the financial-corporate block, shifting all subsequent line numbers by +1 (e.g. 2011-vintage line 44 -> 2018+ line 45; line 28 -> 29; lines 52/53/54/73/74/75/91 -> 53/54/55/74/75/76/92). Line 4 unchanged.
table_renumbering_events.vintages_affected: 2011-2017 vintages share the 2011 line numbers; 2019-2024 vintages share the 2018 line numbers.
table_renumbering_events.impact: Silently breaks any hard-coded 2011-vintage line-number recipe (Shaikh Appendix Table 6.7.11 / XS003 imputed-interest adjustment). Mitigated by the stub-label resolver.

table_renumbering_events.event: 2013 Comprehensive Revision restated FISIM / implicitly-priced financial services by sector. Row ORDER unchanged; the magnitudes each row carries changed.
table_renumbering_events.vintages_affected: Pre-2013 vs 2013+ magnitudes differ; line numbers identical through 2017.
table_renumbering_events.impact: XS003 recipe rows point to the same captions but different values across the 2013 boundary; do not splice.
